turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Your Majesty, I must admit that this revelation comes as a surprise, but I am at your service and will do everything in my power to assist Mr. Holmes in your matter.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Your Majesty's candor is appreciated. Now, let us address the crux of the matter. What is the nature of the document you wish to recover?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: The document in question is a private letter exchanged years ago between myself and a lady of considerable influence, which has now fallen into the wrong hands. It could jeopardize my reign and my family's legacy.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: The implications of this situation are indeed serious. I shall require all the details you can provide, including the identity of the current holder of the letter and any recent communications related to its retrieval.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear the identity of the letter's holder is a sensitive matter, but I shall share all necessary details with you, Mr. Holmes. As for recent communications, I have been in contact with a solicitor who has been attempting to negotiate its return, but to no avail.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Very well, Your Majesty. I shall need the solicitor's name and any correspondence related to the negotiations. Additionally, I require a thorough understanding of the circumstances surrounding the initial exchange of the letter.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I understand, Mr. Holmes. The solicitor's name is Mr. Reginald Thaddeus and the correspondence has been somewhat... delicate. I shall provide you with copies of all letters and any other pertinent information.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I shall also require a detailed account of the letter's content and the circumstances under which it was initially exchanged. The more information I have, the more effectively I can proceed.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Indeed, Mr. Holmes. The letter contains information that is both personal and politically sensitive. It was exchanged under... rather unusual circumstances, many years ago, when I was a young man.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I appreciate your candor, Your Majesty. Now, let us proceed to a more detailed discussion of the events surrounding the initial exchange of the letter.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Mr. Holmes, the circumstances were... unconventional to say the least. The letter was a matter of great personal importance to me, involving a woman with whom I had a passionate but ultimately regrettable affair. I must ask you to maintain the utmost discretion in this matter.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I understand the gravity of the situation, Your Majesty. Mr. Holmes and I will ensure that all details are handled with the utmost confidentiality.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I am aware of your discretion, Dr. Watson. Mr. Holmes, the letter in question was written by the woman in question, years ago when I was a mere prince. It contains information that could potentially undermine my standing as a monarch if it were to fall into the wrong hands.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I assure you, Your Majesty, that Mr. Holmes and I take our professional duties very seriously. We will do everything in our power to protect your interests.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I am counting on you both to handle this with the utmost care. The letter must be retrieved and secured before it can do any further damage. My reputation and the stability of my kingdom are at stake.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Your Majesty, I understand the gravity of the situation. Rest assured, I will proceed with the utmost discretion and vigour. The letter must be recovered without delay.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I trust in your expertise, Mr. Holmes. I will leave the matter in your capable hands and await your success in retrieving the letter. Please keep me informed of any developments.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I will assist Mr. Holmes in every way possible to ensure that Your Majesty's concerns are addressed promptly and discreetly.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Dr. Watson, I trust you will assist me in gathering the necessary details to commence our investigation immediately. We have no time to lose.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Of course, Mr. Holmes. I shall begin by inquiring into the details of the letter and the circumstances surrounding its disappearance.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You had my note? I told you that I would call.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Then I must begin. I must bind you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: I was also aware of that.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?
